fingerprint_definition: SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON for this object with protocol_fingerprint_sha256 omitted; keys sorted; separators=(',', ':'); no trailing newline.
scope: Frozen signed order-flow construction for Phase 4 candidate liquidity-state-transition-eth-btc-v1; definition only, not a trading rule.

microstructure_rationale.aggregation_window: One second is the shortest forward horizon in the frozen Phase 3 protocol and is a conventional immediate order-arrival interval for event-time microstructure measurement. The choice is made from the frozen horizon structure and microstructure reasoning only; it was not selected or tested against forward returns, L2 outcomes, or Phase 4 statistics.
microstructure_rationale.unit_choice: Quote/notional volume expresses the economic amount of aggressive trading and is directly available as price multiplied by executed base volume. Per-asset analyses remain independent, so no cross-asset normalization is introduced.
microstructure_rationale.measure_choice: Raw signed notional preserves both aggressor direction and activity magnitude. No denominator is introduced, avoiding an additional liquidity or participation normalization that was not frozen in the existing protocol.
microstructure_rationale.alignment_choice: The flow interval ends strictly before each L2 source timestamp so the feature uses only trades observable before the L2 event; the event timestamp itself and all later trades are excluded.

flow_measure.signed_flow_formula: SF(T) = sum over trades i with T-1000 <= timestamp_i < T of side_sign_i * price_i * volume_i
flow_measure.buy_notional_formula: B(T) = sum(price_i * volume_i) over buy trades in [T-1000,T)
flow_measure.sell_notional_formula: S(T) = sum(price_i * volume_i) over sell trades in [T-1000,T)
flow_measure.rpi_field: ignored for the signed-flow value; side is the sole aggressor-side field used

timestamp_alignment.anchor: each frozen L2 event's source timestamp field
timestamp_alignment.rule: For an L2 event at integer source timestamp T, use only Bybit trades satisfying T-1000 <= trade_timestamp < T.
timestamp_alignment.causality: strictly causal; trades at timestamp T are excluded even when timestamps are equal; trades after T are excluded.
timestamp_alignment.cross_midnight: The required archive set is treated as one ordered timestamp stream. A one-second window may use the immediately preceding daily archive when it crosses a UTC day boundary, provided the complete interval lies within the accepted overall coverage window.
timestamp_alignment.coverage_boundary: A flow value is valid only when [T-1000,T) is fully contained in the accepted overall Bybit archive coverage [2025-05-01T00:00:00.000Z, 2025-07-30T00:00:00.000Z).
timestamp_alignment.receive_time: No receive timestamp is fabricated or substituted; alignment uses exchange/source timestamps only.

boundary_handling.left_boundary: Include a trade exactly at T-1000 milliseconds.
boundary_handling.right_boundary: Exclude a trade exactly at T.
boundary_handling.daily_archive_boundary: Include records from either adjacent accepted daily archive according to the same half-open timestamp rule; do not reset or double-count at midnight.
boundary_handling.overall_window_start: L2 events whose one-second causal interval begins before 2025-05-01T00:00:00.000Z are not flow-valid.
boundary_handling.overall_window_end: L2 events with T greater than 2025-07-30T00:00:00.000Z are not flow-valid because their causal interval would require trades outside the accepted archive window. T exactly equal to the end boundary is allowed.

missing_and_empty_windows.empty_window: If no accepted trade exists in [T-1000,T), output flow_status=EMPTY and signed_flow_usdt=null; do not replace the empty value with zero.
missing_and_empty_windows.missing_archive_or_invalid_day: If any required archive or accepted manifest is unavailable/invalid, output flow_status=UNAVAILABLE and signed_flow_usdt=null for affected alignments and fail the protocol validation gate.
missing_and_empty_windows.missing_trade_fields: A trade with missing/invalid timestamp, price, volume, or side is not used; the existing daily archive acceptance gate must reject the archive before protocol generation.
missing_and_empty_windows.phase4_eligibility: Future flow-only and L2-plus-flow comparisons may use only flow_status=VALID observations. EMPTY and UNAVAILABLE observations are not imputed and are excluded from flow-dependent inference; the L2-only arm does not receive a fabricated flow value.

duplicate_and_order_rules.duplicate_trade_ids: Use the accepted Bybit daily integrity manifests. Any duplicate trade ID is an archive validation failure; records are never silently deduplicated.
duplicate_and_order_rules.trade_id_gaps: Use the accepted daily trade-ID continuity gate. Any gap is an archive validation failure.
duplicate_and_order_rules.timestamp_order: Use the accepted nondecreasing source-timestamp gate. Out-of-order records are an archive validation failure.

determinism.record_order: Process trades ordered by (timestamp, numeric trade ID); the accepted archives already pass the nondecreasing timestamp and unique/continuous ID gates.
determinism.arithmetic: Parse price and volume as base-10 Decimal values and compute notional and sums with a fixed Decimal precision of 50 and ROUND_HALF_EVEN; do not use binary floating-point for the protocol value.
determinism.output: Emit the signed flow as a canonical decimal string in USDT, plus buy_notional_usdt, sell_notional_usdt, trade_count, window_start_ms, window_end_ms_exclusive, and flow_status.
determinism.identical_input: The same accepted archive bytes and the same L2 timestamp bytes produce byte-identical canonical flow records and the same protocol fingerprint.

required_checks: all required Bybit daily manifests remain PASS
all required archive hashes match manifests
flow records can be generated deterministically from accepted archives
flow records align to frozen L2 source timestamps using the half-open causal interval
re-running the same validation produces identical counts and fingerprints
